findings.title: Model router call log file missing

evidence.observation: Model router is configured with log_file /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router directory exists and call logging is active to capture invocation metrics and latency data

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call patterns, and failure tracking

findings.title: Direct LLM API calls in emergency alert summary bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable rather than delegating through model router
Direct invocation of call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable rather than delegating through model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures consistent rate limiting, model governance, keep-alive tracking, and failover capabilities across the intelligence pipeline
